title: 第12章 机魂大悦
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

听了这话，寓乐再一次确认了自己的判断——这个世界的贵族在玩技术垄断和宗教控制。

他不能反驳这一切，因为这也是他这个‘贵族’的立身根本。

只是，血肉鞭挞的声音，也让他无法忽视。

寓乐一直不觉得自己是什么圣人，可这种场面他也真的做不到视而不见。

尤其是，他能做到点什么。

人就这样，对于做不到的事情，其实不会多大的感觉。

就像是大部分人都不会为自己没能拿到诺贝尔奖而懊悔一样，真正让人耿耿于怀的往往是那些——我或许能？

所以，寓乐忍不住想自己目前是不是能做点什么？

不用太多，一点点就好。

至少，这样能让自己好受点，以及骗骗自己善有善报...

对这个世界和自己的处境，感到了前所未有的迷茫的寓乐，试图找到一点虚无缥缈的东西，来安慰自己慌乱的内心。

大门则是小心翼翼的补充道：

“大人，您您或许是忘记了，和您这样尊贵的人不同，我们这些低贱的玩意，只能这样来取悦机魂。”

大门听说上层贵族们，取悦机魂的方法和他们完全不同。

但至于怎么不同。

他就不知道了。

他只是从修女们哪里听说，真正的贵人们是不用付出任何代价，便能随意使用神机的。

因为那是他们的血统和身份赋予他们的权力。

甚至人机圣教的神甫还告诉他们说，流淌着黄金血脉的尊贵者们，仅仅只是出现便能让机魂大悦。以完成不可能完成的奇迹来着？

但那种贵人和他们是完全的两个世界的存在，想来就算是奴们诺尔，都不配让对方踏足。

反正，神甫大人是这么说的。

他也没想过能见到黄金血脉，他只是希望寓乐能够帮他们修好神机。

听着大门的话，寓乐有些好笑又有些绝望。

当然了，搞宗教控制和技术垄断，肯定下面和上面是两套流程啊。

不然让贵族老爷跟着折磨自己吗？

那这套不白搞了？

不过这样也好，我能借口要隐秘，让他们毫不怀疑的离远点的同时，也停下来。

“让他们停下来，然后清场，我一个人好好看看。”

大门急忙应下。

随之呵斥那些还在鞭挞自己的人离开。

这应该是好事，却让那些人充满惊恐道：

“我们还能继续打，求求您，不要让我们下去！”

“只是鞭挞自己不够对吧？我能砍了我的手，我的脚！求您了，求您了！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After hearing this, Yule once again confirmed his judgment - the aristocrats of this world are playing with technological monopoly and religious control.

He couldn't refute all this, because this was also the foundation of his status as a 'noble'.

However, the sound of flesh and blood being whipped made him unable to ignore it.

Yule never felt that he was a saint, but he really couldn't turn a blind eye to this kind of scene.

Especially if he can do something.

People are like this, and they don't really feel much about things they can't do.

Just like most people don’t regret not being able to win the Nobel Prize, what really bothers people are often those--maybe I can?

Therefore, Yule couldn't help but wonder if there was anything he could do now?

Not too much, just a little bit.

At least this will make you feel better, and deceiving yourself will be rewarded...

I felt unprecedentedly confused about the world and my own situation, trying to find something ethereal to comfort my panicked heart.

The door carefully added:

"Sir, you may have forgotten that unlike noble people like you, we lowly things can only please the machine soul in this way."

Damen heard that the upper-class nobles' methods of pleasing machine spirits were completely different from them.

But how is it different?

He doesn't know.

He only heard from the nuns that real nobles can use the divine machine at will without paying any price.

Because that is the power given to them by their blood and identity.

Even the priests of the Man-Machine Holy Cult told them that the noble ones with golden blood could make the machine souls happy just by showing up.To accomplish impossible miracles?

But that kind of noble people and they are two completely different worlds. After all, even the slave Noel is not worthy of letting the other party set foot in it.

Anyway, that's what the priest said.

He didn't expect to see the golden bloodline, he just hoped that Yule could help them repair the divine machine.

Listening to Damen's words, Yule felt a little funny and a little desperate.

Of course, when it comes to religious control and technological monopoly, there must be two sets of processes below and above.

Otherwise, why don't you let the noble master torture you?

Then this set is not in vain?

But this is fine, I can use the excuse to be secretive and let them stay away without any doubt, and at the same time stop.

"Ask them to stop and clear the place. I'll take a good look alone."

The door hurriedly opened.

Then he scolded those who were still beating him and left.

This should be a good thing, but it made those people full of panic and said:

"We can continue to fight, please, don't let us go down!"

"Just whipping yourself is not enough, right? I can chop off my hands and my feet! Please, please!"
